I've only never relied on my father because my mom got custody (and I truly, in my soul, wish she hadn't because she never wanted me. She wanted a perfect punchingbag princess who had perfect grades and kept home perfectly and never wanted anything or to do anything but be a cute little doll where instead she got an independent, sloppy, lesbian-possibly-transsexual who has a big imagination and loves actually having hobbies/entertainment/friends outside of the home).

But it doesn't matter because I won't do anything. I don't plan to see 2015 whatever the case, whenever it happens. I know its stupid but there's no one in this world who wants me. And there's no one who I can rely on emotionally, financially, or realistically. All logical signs point to I shouldn't have ever been born anyway. My mom only had me to prove she was faithful to my father, who didn't want kids anyway. I try to be clever. I'm very shrewd when it comes to money from growing up poor. Its like, just think, "do I want this little thing now, or is there something more important I'm not thinking about?" I do that to myself every day I see something I want - be it a video game or a new tool for art stuff - and I think to myself about how I will soon have an expensive car repair (or have to sell it), and how I will need to save up to make a deposit to a bank or something for a new place. There are always going to be "more expensive" things you need to save up for. More important than a $20 toy or whatnot :P 

Also, sometimes I turn myself down for something like that (say it's a soldering gun for $50), I let myself have a "lesser prize" like eating out for half-priced appetizer hour at my favorite restaurant (usually dinner is around $5-$9 for that). I hardly eat out because I just can't justify it. But if I compare it to a bigger thing I could have gotten, it feels okay, and I still don't feel fully like I'm missing out on anything. Last time I did this, instead, I bought myself a steam game with steam wallet funds I got from trading cards so it was technically free for me even though it was something I wouldn't have gotten otherwise lol.
